owner: JEMAchievementGuide item-help content projected through JEMCompat into native JEI Information recipes
request: Explain where non-crafted items come from, how to obtain them and why or how to use them. The route must open through ordinary JEI recipe focus and the U uses key

implementation.native_jei_contract: JEI 15.49.0.194 Information recipes expose the same item as a visible INPUT and an invisible OUTPUT. INPUT focus supports U and OUTPUT focus supports ordinary recipe lookup
implementation.selector_contract: Every exact registered item ID in jem_items, jem_aliases or a spotlight selector is projected. Authored item pages take priority over generated quest projections
implementation.description_contract: Each JEI recipe uses the description of its exact source entry instead of reselecting the first tooltip entry for that item

curated_examples.where: Armed Piglin Cultists and Cultist Riders associated with the Luminous Nether cultist group
curated_examples.how: Rare native mob-equipment drop. Looting improves equipment-drop chances
curated_examples.purpose: Axe tool and melee weapon with installed tier durability 1200, mining speed 6 and attack bonus 5
evidence: Installed Luminous Nether 1.3.3 entity bytecode equips the item in the main hand
Installed GoldCultistAxeItem bytecode supplies the native axe tier values

curated_examples.where: The Scarecrow encounter in plains during a full moon
curated_examples.how: The installed Scarecrow death procedure drops one helmet. Horseless Headsman also has a separate conditional route
curated_examples.purpose: Head armor with 3 armor and 363 durability. It refreshes Strength during a full moon

curated_examples.where: Temple to Methuselah in jungle biomes
curated_examples.how: The installed Methuselah boss death method drops one eye
curated_examples.purpose: Activates a complete Forgotten Portal whose four corners select one Cenozoic era

curated_examples.where: Stronghold, Bastion, Nether Fortress, Desert Pyramid, Jungle Temple, Ocean Ruin and Buried Treasure chests, plus spawner breaking
curated_examples.how: Installed global loot modifiers add one orb with an exact per-table condition. JEM has spiritOrbGens enabled
curated_examples.purpose: Four orbs buy one Heart Container or Stamina Vessel at a Goddess Statue

curated_examples.where: Horned Statue bargains in village, underground and Nether statue structures
curated_examples.how: Sell one Heart Container or Stamina Vessel for one Essence and five emeralds
curated_examples.purpose: Use the held item to add one internal essence. One essence plus six emeralds buys a vessel back at a Horned Statue
evidence: Installed Paraglider 20.1.3 horned statue bargain recipes

runtime_status: Source and static JEI API review complete. Minecraft launch and player acceptance were not performed
